_comment: CedarFix data manifest — sha256 + row count + split role + provenance. Generated 2026-06-01.
_warning: DO NOT use validation or test_locked files as training input. DO NOT modify locked files.

files.description: IEP-1 classifier training set. Enriched CedarFix v29 batch8 JSONL. The ONLY file used by semantic_classifier.py for training.
files.generation_note: Generated by CedarFix v29 batch8 pipeline with v14 enrichment pass.

files.description: IEP-1 hyper-parameter validation set. Same distribution as train — NOT used in any eval. Only for model selection during training.
files.generation_note: 20% hold-out of batch8 pipeline output. Deliberately excluded from ablation evaluation to prevent leakage.

files.description: LOCKED test set. Used exclusively in evaluate_ai_ablation.py. DO NOT modify or use for training.
files.generation_note: Batch7 pipeline output, locked as final test artifact. Different batch from train (batch8) but same template distribution — hence high model accuracy in ablation.

files.description: Top-tier quality examples curated from the v29 pipeline for quality reference and future few-shot prompting.
files.generation_note: Manually curated subset of v29 with highest inter-annotator agreement.

files.description: Locked telecom-specific evaluation set. Used for telecom sector regression testing.
files.generation_note: Telecom-focused eval with entity-level routing labels.

files.description: Gold OOD routing eval: WATER sector. 355 independently authored cases. Never in any training file.
files.generation_note: Authored independently. Covers BMLWE, SLWE, WAC entities. Multilingual (arabizi/arabic/english/unknown).

files.description: Gold OOD routing eval: ELECTRICITY sector. 50 independently authored cases. Never in any training file.
files.generation_note: Covers EDL, MOEW entities. Mix of outage, billing, hazard cases.

files.description: Gold OOD routing eval: ROADS sector. 50 independently authored cases. Never in any training file.
files.generation_note: Covers MPWT, MUN entities. Hard negatives for local vs national roads.

files.description: Gold OOD routing eval: WASTE/ENVIRONMENT sector. 50 independently authored cases. Never in any training file.
files.generation_note: Covers MUN, MOE, MOEW entities. ENVIRONMENT aliases to WASTE in eval.

files.description: Gold OOD routing eval: TELECOM sector. 50 independently authored cases. Never in any training file.
Gold OOD routing eval: SAFETY/PSE sector. 50 independently authored cases. Never in any training file.
files.generation_note: Covers ISF, MUN, MoI entities. Public safety and enforcement complaints.

files.description: Gold OOD routing eval: FLOODING sector. 10 independently authored cases. Never in any training file.
files.generation_note: Small set; flooding cases have known divergences (see flooding_routing_known_divergences_v1.jsonl).

files.description: Gold arabizi hard-negative eval. 304 adversarial multilingual arabizi cases with difficulty tiers. Never in any training file.
files.generation_note: Adversarially authored. Includes easy/medium/hard difficulty tiers and difficulty_reason fields. Cross-sector ambiguity cases.

files.description: Gold IEP-6 image hazard fusion eval. 15 manually labeled image+text fusion cases. Never in any training file.
files.generation_note: Manually labeled image cases with expected hazard type, entity, and conflict_detected flag. Expandable to 80-100 cases.

files.description: Gold IEP-8 resolution grounding eval. 14 cases with expected resolution steps and KB citations. Never in any training file.
files.generation_note: Tests IEP-8 resolution co-pilot KB grounding accuracy.

split_policy.rule: Only 'train' role files may be used in model training. 'test_locked' and 'gold_ood_eval' files are immutable eval artifacts.
split_policy.leakage_prevention: cidarfix_v29_batch8_val_v14_enriched.jsonl was previously included in training (bug fixed 2026-06-01). It is now excluded. Its sha256 must never appear in TRAINING_PATHS.
split_policy.eval_independence: gold_ood_eval files were authored independently of the training pipeline. They represent genuinely out-of-distribution civic complaints.
